title: SEO Validation Report
description: Output contract of the seo-ranking skill's validation gate (module 19, VALIDATION.md, checks SEO-V01..SEO-V40). One report is emitted per article at the VALIDATE phase: a PASS/WARNING/FAIL verdict, per-section check results (Content, On-Page, Technical, AI Search), the issue list where every issue carries type/severity/check/location/problem/why_it_matters/recommended_fix, the score summary, the data_availability block stating which inputs were real, and next actions. The Technical section (SEO-V31..V35) is SITE-LEVEL: in the article-generation pipeline it is always NOT_MEASURABLE (technical data is never fetched as a side effect of generating an article — robots/sitemap/crawl/CWV belong to the CMS's SEO dashboard). Issue `type` values come from the canonical registry in VALIDATION.md; UNAVAILABLE or NOT_MEASURABLE markers are honest limitations, never failures.

check_id.description: A validation check ID from VALIDATION.md (SEO-V01..SEO-V40; new checks start at SEO-V41).

issue_type.description: snake_case issue type from the canonical registry in VALIDATION.md (e.g. keyword_stuffing, missing_meta_description, cannibalization_high); extend only via SEO-V41+.

check_section.description: Result block for one section of the check catalog. `status` is included where relevant: MEASURABLE (checks ran with the data they need), NOT_MEASURABLE (the whole section needs data that is absent), or UNAVAILABLE (specific inputs such as cms_inventory were missing, so individual checks could not run).

status.description: Only present where relevant; the Technical section always carries it.

checks_run.description: IDs of the checks that actually ran in this section (empty when the section is NOT_MEASURABLE).

issue_count.description: Number of issues in the report produced by this section's checks.

technical_section.description: The Technical section (SEO-V31..V35) — SITE-LEVEL maintenance checks. Without technical_data the whole section is NOT_MEASURABLE with an empty checks_run — never failed, never guessed; and technical_data is never present in the article-generation pipeline, so NOT_MEASURABLE is that pipeline's only state (the section activates only in explicit maintenance contexts). Technical health is never inferred from correct title/meta/H1.

issue.description: One finding by one check. All seven fields are obligatory, no exceptions (VALIDATION.md): what is wrong, where, why it matters to search or readers, and what to do about it.

severity.description: CRITICAL blocks publishing; WARNING should be fixed (core-field warnings cap the verdict at WARNING); INFO is an optional opportunity that never blocks.

location.description: Where the problem lives: a heading, a metadata field, the JSON-LD block, the URL, etc.

why_it_matters.description: The concrete impact on search visibility or readers — never boilerplate.

recommended_fix.description: The actionable fix for the flagged problem.

count.description: How many issues of this type were deducted in the category.

amount.description: Total points deducted (two decimals; capped at the category weight).

name.description: Category name exactly as defined in SCORING.md.

weight.description: Category weight; weights are tunable configuration and must sum to 100 per score.

earned.description: Points kept after deductions (two decimals; 0 <= earned <= weight).

deductions.description: Every lost point traces to an issue object in the validation report.

skill_version.description: Semantic version of the seo-ranking skill that produced the report.

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of report generation, e.g. 2025-01-15T10:30:00Z.

article.description: The article the gate validated, as the CMS knows it.

title.description: The article's SEO title; an empty string means the CMS holds no title (reported as missing_title).

slug.description: The article slug or URL path.

url.description: Final public URL when known; null pre-publish or when the CMS cannot resolve it.

word_count.description: Word count of the article body (headings included, boilerplate excluded).

primary_keyword.description: The primary keyword the article targets.

intent.description: The intent analysis the gate ran against (from SEARCH-INTENT.md, or derived in-gate with confidence 'low' when the PLAN output was missing).

primary_intent.description: The classified search intent of the target query.

main_question.description: The single question the searcher most wants answered.

verdict.description: Per VALIDATION.md: any CRITICAL issue, Content Score < 70, or Technical Score < 40 (when measurable) means FAIL; no criticals plus a core-field warning, Content Score 70-84, or Technical Score < 70 means WARNING; Content Score >= 85 with no criticals and no core-field warnings means PASS.

sections.description: Per-section results for the four check groups of the VALIDATION.md catalog.

issues.description: All issues found by the gate, ordered by severity then check ID; empty for a flawless article.

scores.description: Score summary per SCORING.md. The full three-score output (with technical categories and formulas) is the separate seo-score.schema.json contract; content_score_categories is the optional in-report traceability of the content score.

content_score.description: SEO Content Score: computed with two decimals per SCORING.md, reported as the rounded final integer.

technical_score.description: Technical SEO Score, or null when technical_status is NOT_MEASURABLE.

technical_status.description: NOT_MEASURABLE is the honest default without real crawl/platform data — it is not a zero and not a pass, and it is the only state in the article-generation pipeline.

overall.description: Overall SEO Health: 0.7 x content + 0.3 x technical when both are measurable, otherwise content-only.

grade.description: A >= 90, B 80-89, C 70-79, D 60-69, F < 60. The score never overrides the verdict.

basis.description: Exactly what the overall number rests on, e.g. 'content-only' or 'content+technical (0.7/0.3)'.

content_score_categories.description: Optional: per-category traceability of the SEO Content Score, in the same category shape as seo-score.schema.json (SCORING.md worked-example style). Validating consumers may ignore it.

data_availability.description: Which inputs were real, so a human can see exactly what the conclusions rest on (Data Availability Policy, SKILL.md section 5).

serp_data.description: Real SERP results were supplied to the gate.

search_console.description: A real Search Console export was supplied.

cms_inventory.description: The real CMS page inventory was supplied (title uniqueness, internal links, anchors).

technical_access.description: Real crawl/platform data was supplied for the Technical section.

next_actions.description: What to do next, in priority order — e.g. 'Publish', scheduled fixes, or 'Fix the CRITICAL issues and re-run'.
